subject: Attorney's Fees
title: PERC AF-2015-004 Final Order (Attorney's Fees)
text:
STATE OF FLORIDA
PUBLIC EMPLOYEES RELATIONS COMMISSION
FLORIDA STATE LODGE,
FRATERNAL ORDER OF POLICE,
Charging Party, Case No. AF- 2015 -004
(Relates to CA- 2014 -067)
v.
FINAL ORDER
TOWN OF DAVIE,
Order Number: 15U -223
Date Issued: July 27, 2015
Respondent.
Alan S. Diamond, Melbourne, attorney for charging party.
Paul T. Ryder, Sunrise, attorney representing agency.
On July 7, 2015, the hearing officer issued an order indicating that the parties have
reached and executed a mutually acceptable settlement agreement that resolves this
attorney's fees case. The hearing officer further recommended that the Commission
close this case. Neither party filed exceptions to the hearing officer's order. Accordingly,
the recommended order is adopted as part of this order and the case is CLOSED.
This order and the May 7, 2015, order on the merits of the unfair labor practice
charge in Case No. CA- 2014 -067 may be appealed to the appropriate district court of
appeal. A notice of appeal must be received by the Commission and the district court of
appeal within thirty days from the date of this order. Except in cases of indigency, the
court will require a filing fee and the Commission will require payment for preparing the
record on appeal. Further explanation of the right to appeal is provided in Sections
120.68 and 447.504, Florida Statutes (2014), and the Florida Rules of Appellate
Procedure.

AF-2015-004
(Relates to CA-2014-067)
It is so ordered.
DELGADO and POOLE, Commissioners, concur.

TOWN OF DAVIE, HEARING OFFICER'S
RECOMMENDED ORDER
Respondent.
Alan S. Diamond, Melbourne, attorney for charging party.
Paul T. Ryder, Sunrise, attorney for respondent.
MORTON, Hearing Officer.
On July 6, 2015, the Respondent filed a status report and notice of settlement.
The notice indicates that the parties have reached and executed a mutually acceptable
settlement agreement that resolves this attorney's fee case. Accordingly, I forward this
case to the Commission with the recommendation that it close the case.
Any party may file exceptions to my recommended order, but exceptions must be
received by the Commission within fifteen days from the date of this order. See Fla.
Admin. Code Rule 28- 106.217(1).
ISSUED and SUBMITTED to the Public Employees Relations Commission in
accordance with Florida Administrative Code Rule 28- 106.216 and SERVED on all
parties this day of July, 2015.
